why_a_separate_file: the run_ref executor pins the bytes of the preregistration and the spec (FROZEN_PROTOCOL_SHA256, FROZEN_SPEC_SHA256 of p0_llm_batch2_execution.py), and a commit cannot contain its own SHA; editing either file would change the hashes the run_ref checks. Both stay byte for byte as merged in #186, run_ref null included; this file is the amendment

run_ref.what: the executor (PR 2 of spec §12) on top of 4c60aae; the smoke and the batch run from a clean checkout of this tag, and each stage's receipt names it as executor_sha

product_base.rule: git diff <product_base> <run_ref> -- <paths> is empty: only the executor and its evaluation differ. The executor checks it (product_changes) before claiming a receipt and before every model client of a paid run
